notes: Locals and visitors; leash holder 18+, keiki 8+ with guardian. Donation $50 kama'aina / $150 visitors; book online for 9 or 10 a.m. check-in at the Mo'ili'ili (Honolulu) or Kosasa Ho'opili ('Ewa Beach) campus, dog back by 4 p.m.; enclosed vehicle/pet Uber needed.
Locals and visitors age 21+ with driver's license; apply online and staff match you. Pick-up Tue-Sat 9:30-11 a.m., return by 4 p.m.; minimum donation at pick-up (site lists both $35 and $25).

Visitors and kama'aina 18+; pick-up 10 a.m.-12 p.m. daily except Thursdays (walk-in or book online), return by 5 p.m. Visitors $75 donation per group, kama'aina free with ID; credit card and enclosed vehicle required.

Visitors and residents 18+ (kids may come if noted, adults handle the dog); $75 participation fee. Pre-register via Calendly (slots open 10 days ahead) or ask about walk-ins; no walk-ins Wednesdays, shelter open Mon-Tue, Thu-Sat 11-5.

Adults 18+ (children 8+ with adult); Fri-Sun by online appointment at the Kona (Holualoa) or Keaau shelter, return by 4:30 p.m. Donation $15 per group with Hawaii ID, $35 non-residents; enclosed vehicle, one dog per vehicle.
Shelter & sanctuary at 87-120 Kaukamana Rd (Ma'ili); adoptions listed via Adopt-a-Pet. No day-out program on its site.
